# Health Autonomy

> Clinic-based health, longevity and physical performance assessments at Chudleigh Health Hub, 90 Fore Street, Chudleigh, Devon TQ13 0HT (between Exeter and Newton Abbot). One 45-minute, needle-free appointment covers six tests plus a calculated VO2 max, with a green/amber/red report on the day and a personal plan. Assessments are delivered by John Evans, Registered Osteopath (GOsC 6171). Prices start at £150.

Areas served: Chudleigh, Newton Abbot, Exeter, Teignbridge and the wider Devon area.

This is a health and fitness baseline, not a medical diagnosis. If any results need additional checking, clients are advised of the next step.

## Pages

- [Assessments, packages and FAQs](https://irehab.github.io/health-autonomy-website/): what is measured, how it works, the three packages and prices, and common questions.
- [The science behind the assessment](https://irehab.github.io/health-autonomy-website/the-science.html): what each test measures, why it matters and how to prepare.
- [Longevity: A Guide to a Longer, Healthier Life](https://irehab.github.io/health-autonomy-website/book.html): John Evans' free online book on exercise, strength, mobility, balance, sleep, nutrition, emotional and metabolic health, with a nine-test Longevity Check.

## The six tests (plus calculated VO2 max)

- Body composition: Tanita MC-780MA segmental analysis (muscle and fat per limb and trunk, visceral fat, body water, phase angle).
- Metabolic health: skin autofluorescence scan with the AGE Reader (advanced glycation end-products).
- Heart: resting 12-lead ECG.
- Recovery and stress: heart rate variability with the Frontier X2 chest strap.
- Lungs: spirometry (FVC, FEV1, lung age) and blood oxygen (SpO2).
- Power and balance: VALD ForceDecks force plates (peak power, left/right asymmetry).
- VO2 max: calculated from assessment data, so no treadmill test to exhaustion.

## Packages

- The Longevity Baseline, £150: one 45-minute appointment, six-test assessment, calculated VO2 max, same-day Health Autonomy Report and printed Longevity booklet.
- The 60-Day Programme, £375 (most popular): everything in the Baseline, plus a 45-minute goal-setting consultation, a written 60-day plan including nutrition, and a full retest at 8 weeks.
- The Complete Overhaul, £595: everything in the 60-Day Programme, plus four 45-minute clinical sessions for osteopathic treatment, 1-to-1 rehab coaching and supervised recovery (compression boots, PEMF, red light and near-infrared light therapy).

Prices correct at time of publication.
